description: Metadata for golden dataset version 1.0 with 1-10 relevance scoring

relevance_guidelines.9-10: Direct, highly valuable match; ideal result
relevance_guidelines.7-8: Strong, clearly useful but not perfect
relevance_guidelines.5-6: Moderately useful; supports or complements intent
relevance_guidelines.1-2: Edge-case relevance; include only if defensible

coverage_approach: Comprehensive evaluation with 1-10 relevance scoring. Broad queries (q001-q008) include extensive results spanning multiple relevance tiers. Specific tool queries (q009-q018) focus on category-specific matches with scores 3-10. Service provider queries (q019-q026) emphasize provider capabilities with scores 5-10. No artificial caps on result counts—relevance determines inclusion.
notes: Regenerated golden dataset with comprehensive 1-10 relevance scoring replacing previous 1-3 scale. All 26 queries processed with 2,009 total judgments. Relevance evaluated solely from query text and item descriptions without pre-classifying user intent. Mixed categories expected for ambiguous queries. Scores 9-10 represent ideal matches, 7-8 strong matches, 5-6 moderate utility, 3-4 weak/long-tail relevance, and 1-2 edge cases.
